_comment: PasskeyRow, one row of the my-passkeys query on the Passkeys page (generic passkeys page PRD D2),
shipped by MintPlayer.Spark.Authorization. A virtual row type: no clrType, and its rows are the
signed-in user's SparkUser.Passkeys, built per request by Custom.MyPasskeys (PasskeyRowActions),
which reads the request principal and nothing else -- never the page it is shown on.
HAND-AUTHORED. The ids are UUIDv5 of 'authorization:PasskeyRow[.attributes|queries.<Name>]' (D5),
Only Query is granted on this type (the library's security.json), never Read: the rows have no
detail page. Rename and Remove are the row actions RenamePasskey and RemovePasskey; with no New
or Delete right the grid offers neither. A row's id is the base64url credential id.
